rationale: The first reply gave the right plan (clean seal, drawer and filter, hot maintenance wash, leave the door ajar). Later turns went off track: the assistant asked about drain smell and burning smell after the customer had described only a musty smell, and the canned 'Next:' lines ignored what the customer had just said. It then pushed seal replacement and asked for the model number before cleaning was tried. It never asked about wash temperature or softener use, or the ignored drum clean light, which were the likely root causes. The final reply did advise cleaning first, but the part-catalogue message left the customer with an unneeded part path.
